component.name: Duragon
component.summary: A quiet local-first notebook where an AI mind reads along

description.p: Duragon is a local-first desktop notebook where an AI mind reads along, asks questions in the margin, answers inline when addressed, and sketches step-by-step diagrams. Notes are stored in SQLite, voice runs offline on CPU, and AI works with local CLIs, HTTP APIs, or local Ollama servers.
